The '''Mission to Vondarc''' took place several months after the creation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During their search for [[Dass Jennir]], the crew of the ''[[Uhumele]]'' raided the Imperial guard station to hack into the Imperial [[Memory bank/Legends|databanks]] for clues on Jennir.
